gbm_population_evidence.quote: For Arm A: Participants who have had a prior resection of diagnosed glioblastoma, IDH wildtype (2021 WHO grade 4)

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Quisinostat: a highly potent and orally active HDAC inhibitor

Patients with tumors demonstrating a positive pharmacokinetic (PK) response in the Phase 0 component of the study will graduate to an Expansion Phase that combines therapeutic dosing of quisinostat plus standard-of-care fractionated radiotherapy (RT).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase 0 With Expansion Phase Clinical Trial of Quisinostat Plus Radiotherapy in Newly-diagnosed and Recurrent Grade 4 IDH-Wildtype Glioblastomas

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Total and unbound quisinostat concentration will be quantified in Gd-enhancing and Gd-non-enhancing tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery.
Quisinostat concentration will be quantified in cerebrospinal fluid collected during Phase 0 surgery

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor tissue collected during surgery will be compared to baseline tissue to assess fold induction change of AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, and MIB-1.

role_evidence.quote: Participants with tumors demonstrating PK response will continue with therapeutic dosing of quisinostat treatment on Monday, Wednesday, Friday of 5-day cycles after surgery concurrently with their standard of care (SOC) fractionated RT.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: a highly potent and orally active HDAC inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: Participants must be willing to receive prophylaxis with levetiracetam for the duration of study drug administration (or alternative anti-epileptic if agreed with Medical Monitor).

source_quote.quote: Participants undergoing resection for a suspected newly diagnosed WHO Grade 4 glioblastoma, IDH wildtype.
Tumor tissue collected during surgery will be compared to baseline tissue to assess fold induction change of AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, and MIB-1.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: pH2AX, cleaved caspase-3, MIB-1 in tumour

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue collected during surgery will be compared to baseline tissue to assess fold induction change of AcH3K9/14, pH2AX, ClCas-3, and MIB-1.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CSF tumour DNA / cell-free DNA genomic changes and CSF tumour RNA transcriptome

source_quote.quote: Genomic changes will be assessed by sequencing DNA from tumor cells and/or cell-free DNA in CSF collected during Phase 0 surgery

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (Phase 0/1b, translational subset). Quisinostat is the only investigational drug; expansion adds SOC fractionated radiotherapy (no temozolomide stated), so regimen combination with radiotherapy. Two experimental arms by setting (recurrent / newly diagnosed); neither is a control. Entry to expansion depends on tumour 'PK response' (unbound concentration >=0.5 nM), a drug-level criterion, not a molecular biomarker. Levetiracetam prophylaxis required for all patients (supportive).
